description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Saves the user's salary floor, dealbreakers, priorities and companies to avoid, so every agent and session starts from them. Save only what the user said or confirmed in their own words; only the fields you pass change. Roles, seniority, cities and work mode are set on the website (preferences_url in get_search_profile).

avoid_companies.description: Company slugs or names the user does not want. Replaces the saved list; [] clears it.

dealbreakers.description: What makes a job a skip, e.g. "onsite outside HCM", "outsourcing". Replaces the saved list; [] clears it.

priorities.description: What matters most, in order. Replaces the saved list; [] clears it.

salary_basis.description: Whether salary_floor is gross or net.

salary_floor.description: The lowest pay the user accepts.

name: update_search_profile
title: Update my search profile
